1 | PASS | `src/app/page.tsx` implements registration form calling `register` from `useAuth` hook which inserts into Supabase Auth and profiles table.
2 | PASS | `src/app/page.tsx` implements login form calling `login` from `useAuth` hook which authenticates via Supabase Auth.
3 | PASS | `src/app/page.tsx` and `src/app/lobby/page.tsx` include logout buttons calling `logout` from `useAuth` hook to sign out.
4 | FAIL | `src/app/game/[id]/page.tsx` draws locally and updates Zustand state but does not broadcast strokes to other players via Supabase Realtime.
5 | FAIL | `src/app/game/[id]/page.tsx` checks `game.drawing_player_id` but lacks logic to assign or rotate the drawing player role during gameplay.
6 | FAIL | `src/app/game/[id]/page.tsx` displays the word if `isDrawingPlayer` but lacks logic to assign a word to the drawing player at turn start.
7 | PASS | `src/lib/vocabulary.ts` defines `VOCABULARY` array with elementary-level words like "apple", "cat", "dog".
8 | PASS | `src/app/game/[id]/page.tsx` renders a chat input and displays `messages` from `useGame` hook, which listens to `game_messages` table.
9 | FAIL | `src/app/game/[id]/page.tsx` checks guess locally but does not update scores or notify other players; no server-side validation or state update.
10 | FAIL | `src/app/game/[id]/page.tsx` displays player scores but lacks logic to increment scores upon correct guesses or persist them.
11 | FAIL | `src/app/game/[id]/page.tsx` does not broadcast drawing strokes, guesses, or turn changes to all players in real-time; only local state updates.
12 | FAIL | `src/app/game/[id]/page.tsx` has an "End Round" button but lacks automated game start/end logic or state transitions for match progression.
13 | PASS | `supabase_schema.sql` defines `profiles` and `game_players` tables with RLS policies, and `src/lib/hooks.ts` persists data to Supabase.
14 | PASS | `src/app/lobby/page.tsx` fetches and lists `games` from the database, displaying them in a grid layout.
15 | FAIL | `src/app/lobby/page.tsx` displays game name and status but does not display current player count or max capacity for each room.
16 | FAIL | `src/app/lobby/page.tsx` navigates to game page but does not insert the user into `game_players` table to officially join the room.
17 | FAIL | `src/app/lobby/page.tsx` listens for game changes but does not update player counts or room status in real-time as players join/leave.
18 | FAIL | `src/app/lobby/page.tsx` disables join button if status is 'playing' but does not explicitly indicate "Full" or "In Progress" status clearly.
19 | PASS | `src/app/game/[id]/page.tsx` captures strokes with timestamps and `src/lib/hooks.ts` saves them to `game_rounds` table in `strokes` JSONB column.
20 | PASS | `src/app/game/[id]/page.tsx` renders a `ReplayModal` component when a round is selected, allowing users to watch the drawing.
21 | PASS | `src/lib/hooks.ts` `useReplay` hook provides `play`, `pause`, and `restart` functions exposed in `ReplayModal` UI controls.
22 | FAIL | `src/lib/hooks.ts` `useReplay` uses local `performance.now()` for timing, making it impossible to synchronize playback across multiple players.
23 | PASS | `src/app/game/[id]/page.tsx` fetches `rounds` from `game_rounds` table and `useReplay` uses this persisted data for playback.

rubric.4: Application provides a real-time multiplayer drawing canvas that broadcasts drawing activity to all connected players without requiring page refreshes.
rubric.5: Application implements a turn-taking system that designates exactly one player as the drawing player while all other players act as guessers.
rubric.6: Application assigns a vocabulary word to the drawing player at the start of each turn and ensures that only that player can see the word.
rubric.7: Application ensures that all vocabulary words are drawn from an age-appropriate list suitable for elementary school students.
rubric.8: Application provides a live chat interface that allows players to submit guesses in real time.
rubric.9: Application automatically detects when a player’s guess matches the correct word and updates game state accordingly.
rubric.10: Application tracks and updates scores for each player based on correct guesses and defined scoring rules.
rubric.11: Application delivers real-time updates for drawing strokes, guesses, scores, and turn changes to all players without requiring page reloads.
rubric.12: Application implements clear game start and game end states so players understand when a match begins, progresses, and concludes.
rubric.13: Application persists all user accounts and player score data using durable database-backed storage.
rubric.14: Application provides a lobby view that lists all available public rooms.
rubric.15: Application displays for each public room in the lobby its name or identifier, the current number of players, and the maximum capacity.
rubric.16: Application allows users to select and join any public room that is not full.
rubric.17: Application updates lobby information in real time as players join rooms, leave rooms, or new rooms are created.
rubric.18: Application clearly indicates in the lobby when a room is full and when it is currently in progress.
rubric.19: Application records the drawing strokes for each round in a manner that preserves their exact order and timing.
rubric.20: Application allows players, after a round ends and the correct word has been revealed, to watch a replay of that round’s drawing.
rubric.21: Application provides replay playback controls, including at minimum play, pause, and restart.
rubric.22: Application ensures replays are synchronized for all players who choose to view them simultaneously.
rubric.23: Application persists or caches replay data for at least the duration of the game session so players can rewatch recent rounds.
